# DSH Git Commit [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@eternalheart/dsh-git-commit) [](https://www.npmjs
.com/package/@eternalheart/dsh-git-commit) [](LICENSE) [](https://github.com/wh131462/dsh-git-commit
com/package/@eternalheart/dsh-git-commit) [](LICENSE) [](https://github.com/wh131462/dsh-git-commit)
中文 · **English**
**DSH Git Commit** is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns the composer into a one-click, model-plan
ned commit. It detects Git or SVN and lets the session's current model decide how many commits the c
hange set should become, which files belong together, and the Angular message for each — then runs t
he VCS itself after you confirm. No chat message, no agent turn, no tool calls.
## Interface
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The same flow works in a Git repository and in an SVN working copy; `vcs: auto` picks one, and `vcs:
git` / `vcs: svn` pin it.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Features
- **Visible progress, in the dialog.** Clicking opens the dialog immediately: “Reading the working t
ree” plus a rule-based preview, then “Planning the groups with <model>”, then “Committing”. Closing

the dialog aborts the model call.
- **Git and SVN.** `auto` prefers Git when both exist (a git-svn c
heckout), otherwise the SVN working copy. Git commits stage explicit paths; SVN commits schedule new

files with `svn add` and commit explicit paths, one revision per group.
- **The model plans the gro
ups, the host checks them.** The model receives a numbered list of every changed path (status, path,
type hint, and the diff within budget) and decides the group count and membership, then names each
group; `maxGroups` is only a ceiling. The host enforces coverage: files the model never claimed are
grouped by the rules, repeated or out-of-range numbers are ignored, and no path is dropped. Docs, te
sts, CI, and build types are locked to what the path says; only source groups may pick `fix` / `refa

ctor` / `perf`.
- **Semantic messages, always.** Every group is named by the model, and count-only s
ubjects ("modified 5 files", "update files") are rejected outright. Headers are normalized, then inv
alid ones get a targeted repair round; groups the model missed, split out, or merged are sent back t
o the model for naming. A group that still has no valid message stays blank and blocks the commit, w
hile the rule fallback names concrete files or areas (never file counts) and the dialog flags the gr

oups that still need a better name.
- **No agent turn and no command.** The button calls the plugin'
s own JSON channel on the host, so no `command/run` node is appended, no chat message is added, no t

ools run, and a model transport failure cannot leave a commit stuck in the conversation.
- **The rul
es live in code.** `@commitlint/config-angular` is enforced by the host: one type per commit, header

≤ 72, subject ≤ 50, explicit paths, no `--amend` / `--force` / `--no-verify`.
[该节后续省略]
## Installation
### DeepSeek Harness
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Or from the Web sidebar: **Plugins → Add plugin** and paste the same spec. The plugin installs into
the current profile and applies to every session in it.
### Requirements
- DeepSeek Harness with the standard host services (`webServer`, `connection`, `sessions`, `workingD

irectory`, `llm`, `agentDefaultModel`) and client slots.
- `git` and/or `svn` on `PATH`; the plugin
also probes `/usr/bin/git`, `/opt/homebrew/bin/git`, `/usr/local/bin/git`, `/usr/bin/svn`, `/opt/hom

ebrew/bin/svn`, and `/usr/local/bin/svn`, so a Finder-launched app works.
- A usable model route for
semantic messages. Set `useModel: false` to skip the model and write every message by hand.
## Usage
1. Click **提交 / Commit** in the composer tool row. The dialog opens immediately with “Reading the wo

rking tree…”.
2. The host reads `git status` / `svn status --xml` and shows a rule-based preview gro
uping; it then sends the numbered path list to the session's model, which decides the final group co
unt and membership and writes the message for each. Slow models keep the progress banner and the but

ton in a busy state.
3. Review the groups — each is an editable textarea plus file chips. To fix a g
rouping, select files and choose a target (or “New group”), drag a file onto another group, or use ↑
to merge a group into the one above. Changed groups are tagged, and their messages may need a match

ing edit.
4. Press **确认提交 / Commit**. The host re-analyzes the working tree, checks that the (edited
) groups cover the changed paths exactly, validates every message, and only then commits group by gr

oup.
5. The result appears in the dialog, with **重新分析 / Analyze again** after a failure. Closing the
dialog aborts a model call that is still running.
`Escape`, the backdrop, and the close button dismiss the dialog while it is not committing.
### Phases and failures
| Phase | What you see | On failure |
| `analyzing` | Skeleton plus “Reading the working tree…” | The dialog closes and a notice explains

why (clean tree, not a repo) |
| `naming` | Rule preview already listed plus “Planning the groups wi

th <model>…” | Editing opens with the reason; retry naming or write by hand |
| `edit` | Every messa

ge editable | Per-group validation reason under its textarea |
| `committing` | Everything locked pl

us “Committing…” | Per-group result; `stale` / staged-index conflicts ask for a re-analysis |
| `don
e` | Result text | A failed run also offers “Analyze again” |

svnPath` | auto | Explicit svn binary; empty probes `/usr/bin/svn`, Homebrew, `/usr/local/bin/svn` |

| `timeoutMs` | `20000` | Deadline for each git / svn invocation |
| `maxGroups` | `12` | Safety ce
iling: the model may use at most this many groups; beyond it whole types are merged and no path is d

may use at most this many groups; beyond it whole types are merged and no path is dropped |
